The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Plate 08231 of the Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), whose numbering puts it on 23 April - the folder's feast day. Captioned Georgy and filed under Category:Icons of Saint George from Russia; 23 April is the great-martyr and trophy-bearer of this folder. The second plate of the day, 08232, is the empress Alexandra martyred with him. Commons describes it: Иллюстрации к книге: Жития святых на русском языке, изложенные по руководству Четьих-Миней  с дополнениями, объяснительными примечаниями и изображениями святых
